mechanism: Amphotericin B causes nephrotoxicity and electrolyte disturbances (hypokalemia, hypomagnesemia) while topiramate is renally cleared and can cause metabolic acidosis and additional electrolyte abnormalities, creating a compounded risk of renal dysfunction and serious electrolyte imbalances.
action: Monitor renal function and electrolytes closely; consider alternative antifungal if possible; adjust topiramate dosing based on renal clearance; supplement potassium and magnesium as needed.
